Research-active and unusually so for this dataset: ResearchGate profile shows 15 publications and ~1,119 reads, with peer-reviewed papers in Experimental and Clinical Transplantation (2020, 2021), Pediatric Transplantation (2021) and the Journal of Liver Transplantation (2022). Holds senior listings at two separate corporate hospital groups (Yashoda and CARE), which is a seniority/market-demand signal. notes:
DISTINCT PERSON FROM ROW 985. Rows 984 and 985 are BOTH liver-transplant/HPB surgeons at Yashoda Secunderabad: row 985 is Dr. Pardhasaradhi P (Liver Transplant, HPB & Minimally Invasive GI Surgeon). They are two different men and I researched them separately with no shared evidence; nothing in this record came from a Pardhasaradhi source. As the brief predicted, 'Yuktansh Pandey' is a North Indian name in a Telugu-majority list and the North India link is real and documented: his liver-transplant/HPB fellowship was in NEW DELHI (Centre for Liver and Biliary Sciences, 2017-2019) and his laparoscopic certification was from Gurgaon (2014) - he was recruited into Hyderabad, not trained there.

IDENTITY: verified on four criteria in one official URL - yashodahospitals.com/doctor/SECUNDERABAD/LIVER-TRANSPLANT-SURGERY/dr-yuktansh-pandey/ - matching the input row's name, specialty (Liver Transplant & HPB Surgery), hospital (Yashoda Hospitals) and branch (Yashoda Hospital Secunderabad), with the page title 'Consultant Liver Transplant & HPB Surgeon'. Band is High on TWO INDEPENDENT OFFICIAL HOSPITAL DOMAINS that agree on name + specialty + city: yashodahospitals.com and carehospitals.com. I did NOT count the several yashodahospitals.com pages (doctor profile, liver-transplant team page, liver-transplant index) as separate sources - one domain is one source.

ORCID DISCARDED - MANDATORY CHECK CAUGHT IT. A WebSearch summary asserted 'Yuktansh Pandey's ORCID is 0000-0002-8864-9968'. No orcid.org URL for him appeared in any result list. I re-searched that exact string in quotes per section 4: it returned NO exact match - only visually similar but different iDs (0000-0002-8733-9968, 0000-0002-8442-9968, 0000-0002-8071-9968, 0000-0002-9381-9968 etc.) belonging to unrelated researchers. The asserted iD exists on no indexed page tied to him, so the orcid field is left BLANK. Do not reinstate it without opening orcid.org directly. His publication record is nonetheless real and independently evidenced by the PubMed Central article and the ectrx.org journal archive entry recorded in other_profiles.

NO EMAIL OR PHONE RECORDED. A ZoomInfo result appeared titled 'Contact Yuktansh Pandey, Email: ****@yashodahospitals.com & Phone Number'. That is a B2B data-broker lead-gen page: the address is deliberately MASKED, the page is not an institutional publication, and completing it into a real address from the yashodahospitals.com domain would be exactly the firstname.lastname fabrication that rule 3 forbids. Rejected outright and not recorded in any field. Credihealth and HexaHealth carry 'book appointment' buttons but those are aggregator helplines, not his line, so appointment_link is left blank - unlike row 980 no doctor-specific Yashoda online-consultation page surfaced for him, and I did not construct one by analogy.

FOR HUMAN REVIEW - WHICH EMPLOYER IS CURRENT: he is published on BOTH hospitals' own sites, and his LinkedIn headline reads 'Transplant Surgeon - CARE Hospitals'. One search summary stated he previously worked at CARE Hospitals and currently practises at Yashoda Secunderabad, which supports the input row, but that ordering is summary-level and not something I could confirm on the page itself. The input row's Yashoda Secunderabad attribution IS directly supported by the official Yashoda URL path, so hospital_profile is populated rather than blanked - this is not the stale-affiliation pattern where the named hospital has no page at all. Still, a human should confirm he is currently at Yashoda and not primarily at CARE Hi-Tech City before any outreach.

CONFLICTING AGGREGATOR DATA, NOT USED: aggregator text asserted '17 years of experience' (vs the input row's 13), a fellowship at Max Superspeciality Hospital Saket 2018 (vs the official page's Centre for Liver and Biliary Sciences 2017-2019), and an internally impossible education timeline - MBBS Gandhi Medical College Bhopal 2008 but MS General Surgery RNT Udaipur 2004, i.e. the MS four years BEFORE the MBBS. Because those aggregator records are demonstrably corrupted, I relied only on the official Yashoda qualifications and left verified_experience as 'stated, not confirmed'. owns_clinic false: hospital-employed consultant, no clinic or personal domain found.
